scope: ERP template update preview and consumer adaptation protection

interpretation.initialBaseline: Recorded after the current ERP template initialization and therefore includes reviewed package, request-adapter, UI and changelog differences as the consumer baseline.
interpretation.reason: There are no template-only changes to apply. The preview did not overwrite or rebuild Demo.
interpretation.database: Liquibase files participate in comparison; the tool does not rewrite executed changesets, clear checksums, delete data or run migrations. Database fixes require a new forward changeset and separate isolated verification.

regression.redGreen: The baseline-adaptation regression first failed, then passed after the minimal classifier fix.
